title: hedyotis lindleyana f. glabricalycina
intro: Hedyotis lindleyana f. glabricalycina, commonly known as the "Chinese chameleon flower," is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, headaches, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis lindleyana f. glabricalycina are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
